result:
The fix is PR #376 in `openmrs-esm-admin-tools` (ticket O3-5993, "Reports app shows literal {parameters} instead of the missing parameter names"), merged as commit `f462a28`. The bug was a brace mismatch: i18next interpolates `{{...}}`, but the message used `{parameters}`, so the names were never substituted. The PR changed the placeholder to `{{parameters}}` in the source string and the English translation. The line that now implements it is `reports-data-overview.component.tsx:77`, which calls `t('missingParameters', 'Please provide the following parameters: {{parameters}}', { parameters: missingParameters.join(', ') })`. The matching English translation is in `translations/en.json:34`.

I read both spans at the merge commit. I did not check the Chinese `zh` and `zh_CN` files. A review comment on the PR flagged that their `missingParameters` strings dropped the placeholder. A reviewer then asked for the other locale files to be reverted and approved the PR, so the final state of those files is unverified.

- Fix (line that implements the message): `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx` lines 73–80, with the interpolation call at line 77
- English translation with the corrected placeholder: `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json` line 34
- The fixing change: PR #376, merge commit `f462a28bf6f97d3a1c963e362b79c31b56f69bd4`
- Ticket: O3-5993
